label: Claude Fable 5.2
output:
Here's a draft you can paste anywhere. It's plain text, so it won't go funny on WhatsApp or Facebook.

---

**I'm safe, and here's what's going on (please forward)**

Hi everyone,

I'm writing one letter because my phone hasn't stopped since Saturday and I can't answer you all one by one. I'd also rather you hear it from me than tenth-hand. Please pass this on to anyone who's been asking.

First thing: I'm safe and I'm not hurt. I'm staying with my sister in Rondebosch, and Marmalade is with me.

WHAT HAPPENED

At about 11:40pm on Saturday 7 November, a fire started in a ground floor flat at Lindale Court on Station Road in Obs. I'm in flat 12 on the second floor. I woke up because our neighbour Uncle Faizel was banging on every door on our floor in his vest and slippers. I grabbed my phone and my cat and went down the stairs with nothing else.

Everyone in all 14 flats got out. Two people were treated for smoke at Groote Schuur and sent home.

The fire department says it was probably an electrical fault, but they're still investigating. I'm not going to guess, and I'd be grateful if we all left that to them.

My flat is basically gone. There's smoke and water through everything and the ceiling came down in the lounge. The landlord says nobody is going back in for at least six weeks, so I need to find somewhere new.

That's the short version, and it's the only one I have in me right now. Marmalade hid under the car for two hours afterwards and I think she had the right idea. Furniture can be replaced. She can't.

THE FUNDRAISER (THE REAL ONE)

My friend Zinhle has set up a BackaBuddy page:

backabuddy.example/thandi-lindale-court

The target is R25 000 and as I write this it's on R11 400, which I can't get my head around. I hate asking for help and I feel strange about a fundraiser with my name on it. Zinhle told me to shut up and accept it, so I'm doing that.

PLEASE WATCH OUT FOR THE FAKE ONE

There is a "Thandi Fire Relief" page on another site, and a WhatsApp message going around asking people to EFT money into a Capitec account. Neither of those is me, and neither is Zinhle. I've reported them.

The only fundraiser is the BackaBuddy page above. If a message asks you to EFT money into a bank account for me, it isn't from me. Please don't pay it, and send this letter to whoever forwarded it to you. If you've already paid into it, I'm so sorry. Please contact your bank.

WHAT I NEED

- Help with the deposit for a new place. That's what the BackaBuddy is for.
- School shoes and work clothes. I'm a size 6 shoe and a size 34.
- A laptop, if anyone has an old one that still works. All my lesson planning was on mine.

If you have shoes, work clothes or a laptop, message me and I'll answer those ones first.

WHAT I DON'T NEED

- More clothes in general. I've been given more than I can wear, and I'll pass the extras on to the other flats.
- Food. My sister's freezer is full.

I say this with love. You've been so generous that I'm running out of space at my sister's.

FOR THE LITTLE ACORNS FAMILIES

To my Ladybirds parents: the concert on 27 November is still happening. Everything I took home to laminate was in the flat, so the 22 crowns and the handprint banner are gone. Please don't worry. The Ladybirds will have crowns.

I'm back at school on Wednesday. Please don't make a big thing of it in front of the children. They're four and five, and I'd like it to be a normal day for them. A wave at the gate is perfect.

THANK YOU

I've cried at every single message. On Sunday at 7am one of the moms from my class dropped a bag of clothes at my sister's place. She didn't even knock, she just left it on the gate. I keep thinking about that, and about Uncle Faizel in his slippers. People have been amazing and I don't have the right words for it yet.

I'll get to comments slowly. Please don't be offended if I don't answer your DM. I've read it and it mattered.

With so much love,
Thandi (and Marmalade)

---

Check these before you post:

- **Wednesday:** today is Wednesday the 11th. If you mean next week, change it to "Wednesday 18 November" so forwarded copies don't confuse anyone.
- **"I'll answer those ones first":** I added that line so people with a laptop or shoes know what to do. Swap in a drop-off point if you'd rather not get more messages.
- **"Please contact your bank":** this is my addition too, for anyone who already paid the fake account. Cut it if you don't want it.
